Name: Castalia Farm
Author: Sinbad37
Description:
Castalia Farm
Looking for a farm that feels like more than just a place to grow crops?
[b]Castalia Farm[/b] is a large, diverse farm designed to give you plenty of space to build, explore and make the land your own. From open fields to forests, waterfalls and coastlines, every area has its own character.


[heading]🌿 A Farm With Room To Grow[/heading]
Castalia Farm offers a large central area dedicated to crops, with plenty of space to organize your fields however you like. The layout also includes dedicated areas for [b]Fish Ponds[/b] and [b]Sheds[/b], making it easy to keep your farm organized while still leaving plenty of room for creativity.
The main farming area is also designed with [b]Junimo Huts[/b] in mind, giving you enough space to organize your crops into neat sections while keeping convenient paths between them.
And don't worry about running out of space — there's plenty of it.


[heading]🌊 Water Everywhere[/heading]
Castalia Farm features several different types of water, including a [b]river, lake and ocean[/b].
They're not just there to make the farm look pretty. Each area has its own fishing pool, meaning the fish you can catch depend on where you're fishing.
[b]River fish in the river. Lake fish in the lake. Ocean fish in the sea.[/b]
The farm also includes a beautiful waterfall area, adding another little corner to explore and decorate around.
The beach provides access to [b]seasonal beach forage[/b], while forage can also naturally appear throughout the rest of the farm.

[heading]🚋 Getting Around[/heading]
It's a big farm, so walking from one side to the other shouldn't feel like a daily workout.
Castalia Farm includes several [b]fast-travel connections throughout the map[/b], making it much easier to move between the different areas of your farm.


[heading]🌲 KnechtWood[/heading]
Connected directly to the farm is [b]KnechtWood[/b], a woodland area with a more secluded, natural atmosphere.
The area provides a convenient source of [b]Hardwood[/b], with stumps returning regularly, giving you a reliable way to gather Hardwood without having to make long trips every day.
KnechtWood also connects directly to the [b]Secret Woods[/b], making it much quicker to reach one of Stardew Valley's best spots for gathering Hardwood.


[heading]♨️ Castalia Hot Spring[/heading]
Hidden away on the farm is the [b]Castalia Hot Spring[/b].
Step into the water, relax for a while and let the spring restore your [b]Energy[/b].
It can be especially useful during the early game, when every bit of Energy matters and a long day of farming can leave you completely exhausted.
Because sometimes the best farming strategy is simply... taking a bath.


[heading]🌾 Make It Yours[/heading]
Castalia Farm was created with one main idea in mind: [b]give you the space to play the way you want.[/b]
Build huge fields, create an orchard, turn the forest into your own little retreat, fill the coast with Fish Ponds, organize your Sheds, or simply leave parts of the landscape untouched.
There's no single way to use Castalia Farm.
[b]It's your farm. Make it yours.[/b]
